whiteNight.blockNavigation.denyPresence:
Do not deny me.
Why dost thou doubt me when I am in front of thine eyes?
whiteNight.blockNavigation.unknownStory: My story is nowhere, unknown to all.
whiteNight.blockExit:
Do not fear, for I am with thee.
Thou shalt not leave until I permit thee.
whiteNight.blockTime:
Do not trust time.
I shall guide thee.
plagueDoctor.apostle.1: “And I say also unto thee, That thou art #1, and upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.”
plagueDoctor.apostle.2: “Tell us, when shall these things be?”
plagueDoctor.apostle.3: “Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them?”
plagueDoctor.apostle.4: “And #3 and #4; and he surnamed them Boanerges, which is, The sons of thunder.”
plagueDoctor.apostle.5: “#5 saith unto him, Lord, show us the Father, and it sufficeth us.”
plagueDoctor.apostle.6: “And as he passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named #6: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.”
plagueDoctor.apostle.7: “But there was a certain man, called #7, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people, giving out that himself was some great one.”
plagueDoctor.apostle.8: “Then said #8, unto his fellow-disciples, Let us also go, that we may die with him.”
plagueDoctor.apostle.9: “#9 answered and saith unto him, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.”
plagueDoctor.apostle.10: “#10 saith unto him, Lord, how is it that thou wilt manifest thyself unto us, and not unto the world?”
plagueDoctor.apostle.11: “From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of Him.”
plagueDoctor.apostle.12: “He answered them, Have not I chosen you twelve, and one of you is a devil?”
blackForest.story.opening: Once upon a time, three happy birds lived in a warm and lush forest.
blackForest.bigBird.arrives:
Big Bird, with its many eyes, decided to watch over the forest for intruders.
For Big Bird's eyes could see very far, and see things we cannot see.
blackForest.longBird.arrives:
To keep the forest's peace, Long Bird weighed the sins of those who entered the forest.
For Long Bird's scale was fair and just, and could weigh any and all kinds of sin.
blackForest.smallBird.arrives: Small Bird decided to punish the creatures' wrongdoings with its beak.
blackForest.apocalypseBird.appears:
Then, in the middle of all the chaotic cries, someone shouted:
“It's the beast! A big, scary monster lives in the black, dusky forest!”
blackForest.egg.bigEyes.destroyed: Big Bird's far seeing eyes were blinded,
blackForest.egg.longArms.destroyed: The head that always gazed upon the cosmos was lowered,
blackForest.egg.smallBeak.destroyed: Small Bird's mouth that could devour anything was shut,
blackForest.apocalypseBird.suppressed:
The bird began to prowl the forest, but there was nothing.
There were no creatures, no sun and moon, and no beast. All that was left was just a bird and the Black Forest.
